items.title: The action of a derivation on a thickening exists and is unique for algebraic spaces over a base space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism of first order thickenings of algebraic spaces over a base algebraic space B and a linear map from the pullback of the differentials to the conormal sheaf, the lemma produces a unique morphism of the thickening pairs obtained by acting with the derivation, and identifies its effect on the structure sheaves. The proof uses the square-zero structure of the conormal sheaf to define the modified map on structure sheaves, verifies the resulting map is a morphism of thickenings over B by checking the algebra structure, and proves uniqueness by comparing two such maps through the difference construction. The construction and its uniqueness via the difference are the substance. Retained author proof at lines 3764-3800.
